segments.title: Permission to Members to be Absent
segments.content_text:
Mr Speaker: I have received a letter from a Member asking for permission to be absent from today's sitting.

Permission granted.

segments.title: Clinic Waiting Times
segments.content_text:
1 Ms Rina Lim asked the Minister for Health what is the median waiting time for a first appointment at public specialist clinics.

The Minister for Health (Dr Aaron Koh): The median waiting time fell from forty days to thirty-two days over the past year. Four more clinics now offer evening appointments.

Ms Rina Lim (Example GRC): Will the Ministry publish waiting times for each clinic?

Dr Aaron Koh: We will publish waiting times for each clinic from next year, so that patients can choose where to go.

segments.title: Community Transport Bill
segments.subtitle: Second Reading
segments.content_text:
Order for Second Reading read.

The Minister for Transport (Ms Grace Ho): Mr Speaker, I beg to move, "That the Bill be now read a second time." The Bill will require community bus operators to publish an accessibility plan every year.

Mr Daniel Ong (Example East GRC): Small operators run only a few buses. I ask the Minister how they will meet the cost of preparing these plans.

Ms Grace Ho: Small operators will have a two-year transition period, and the Land Transport Authority will provide a template for the plan.

Question put, and agreed to.

Bill accordingly read a Second time and committed to a Committee of the whole House.
